## Summary / 变更摘要

Provide a concise overview of the changes and why they are needed. / 简述本次修改内容与原因。

## Linked Issues / 关联议题

- Refs #

## Type Of Change / 变更类型

- [ ] Bug fix (`fix: ...`)
- [ ] New feature (`feat: ...`)
- [ ] Documentation update (`docs: ...`)
- [ ] CI/CD pipeline enhancement (`ci: ...`)
- [ ] Code refactoring (`refactor: ...`)
- [ ] Performance optimization (`perf: ...`)

## Verification Evidence / 验证结果

- Commands run and observed results: / 列出执行的构建与测试命令及结果：

## Pre-Flight Verification Checklist / 提交前检查

- [ ] **Strict Commit Message**: Every commit matches `xxx: xxx xxx xxx`
- [ ] **Lowercase Tracked Files**: All added or modified file paths are strictly lowercase
- [ ] **Title Case Headers And No Emojis**: Documentation headers use Title Case with zero emojis
- [ ] **No Direct Binary Links**: No `.dmg`, `.zip`, `.pkg`, `.exe`, or `.tar.gz` download links in Markdown
- [ ] **Bilingual Parity**: `readme.zh-cn.md` updated when `readme.md` changed (if present)
- [ ] Shared core, multiplayer or server changes received peer review. / 共享核心、联机或服务端的改动已通过同伴审阅。
- [ ] **Checks And Tests Passed**: Lint, typecheck, and unit tests passed
